# André Larsen

> Norwegian FPV drone pilot and cinematographer based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, since 2020. Works across the UAE and worldwide. Winner of the GoPro Million Dollar Challenge (2022).

## Key facts
- Name: André Larsen (born 1998), Norwegian
- Role: FPV drone pilot and cinematographer
- Based in: Dubai, UAE (since 2020), works worldwide
- Went professional: 2017
- Site figures: 120+ projects, 12 countries, 60M+ views
- Award: GoPro Million Dollar Challenge, winner, 2022 (https://gopro.com/en/ae/news/million-dollar-challenge-creator-andre-larsen)
- Nomination: International Motor Film Awards 2024, Best Commercial Film, Kia EV9

## Pages
- [Home](https://andrelarsen.com/): portfolio home

- [Works](https://andrelarsen.com/works): all projects
- [About](https://andrelarsen.com/about): background, awards, press

## Services
- FPV car commercials: Close, high speed camera work on cars, launches and track days.
- Hotel and real estate aerials: One continuous move from the skyline into a building and through its spaces.
- Events and concerts: Flying over crowds and around stages for event films and aftermovies.
- Action and sports: Following athletes and vehicles through the air at speed.
- Film: FPV units for action and chase sequences on feature films.
